mentions.name: Leafle
mentions.description: This app recommends new books to read based on a deeper understanding of the reader's taste than 'people who read X also read Y' suggestions, using LLMs to reverse-engineer what the reader likes in books. It filters recommendations to books that can be borrowed right away from the user's local library and works with ~6,500 public libraries around the world.
mentions.problem: Conventional recommendation methods like 'people who read X also read Y' fail to capture deeper personal reading taste, and suggested books often aren't actually available to borrow from one's local library.
mentions.audience: The author themselves; the app is built mostly for personal use.
mentions.source_excerpt: working on http://leafle.org my app (mostly for me) to find new books to read that I wouldn’t have thought of (mostly recently Cosmicomics) based on a deeper understanding of what I like in books than people who read X also read Y, that I can actually borrow right away from my local library. Works on ~6,500 public libraries around the world.
